battle.name: 孟加拉國解放戰爭
battle.brief: 孟加拉國解放戰爭於一九七一年爆發，東巴基斯坦軍政府鎮壓獨立運動後，印巴軍隊在孟加拉地區交戰。巴基斯坦空軍在戰事中曾運用F-86F噴氣戰鬥機執行攔截、巡邏與對地任務。衝突由三月軍事行動延續至年末，最終以孟加拉國獨立告終，並改變南亞政治格局。

kit.name: F-86F佩刀式戰鬥機
kit.history: F-86F是美國空軍早期單座後掠翼噴氣戰鬥機，憑高速性能與俯衝能力擔任制空、攔截及對地支援，主要編入空軍戰鬥機聯隊。

countries: 這場戰爭的地理範圍，是南亞次大陸東翼的東巴基斯坦，約當今孟加拉國的疆域；西面與印度相接，北面是西孟加拉邦，東面通往印度阿薩姆與緬甸，南面臨孟加拉灣。帕德瑪河、梅格納河、布拉馬普特拉河、沼澤和稻田把地面切成狹窄走廊，橋梁、渡口、潮汐及季風暴雨使機械化部隊必須不斷改道。1971年3月25日以後，巴基斯坦陸軍以達卡、吉大港和科米拉等城市及交通樞紐為支點，運用東巴基斯坦遊騎兵、武裝警察和民兵守住師、旅、砲兵與機場；由孟加拉籍軍人、警察及遊騎兵離隊者組成的孟加拉解放軍，則先在鄉村、河岸和邊境以小單位活動，之後才建立營、旅和聯合指揮。印度於3月27日越過邊境，將部隊投入東巴基斯坦，成為直接交戰的另一方；其部隊由西、北和西北方向推進，並以海空軍支援。孟加拉灣上的印度海軍打擊巴基斯坦在吉大港的艦艇、港內軍事交通與補給節點。戰役可按3月25日至4月的省級軍政結構崩解期、5月至10月的邊界游擊與雨季整補期、11月至12月的聯合攻勢期來追蹤。
countriesEn: The geographic theater of the war was East Pakistan on the eastern side of the South Asian subcontinent, roughly the territory of present-day Bangladesh. It bordered India to the west, West Bengal to the north, Indian Assam and Burma to the east, and the Bay of Bengal to the south. The Padma, Meghna and Brahmaputra rivers, marshes and rice fields cut the land into narrow corridors; bridges, fords, tides and monsoon downpours constantly forced mechanized troops to change route. After March 25, 1971, the Pakistan Army used Dhaka, Chittagong and Comilla as bases, together with the East Pakistan Rifles, armed police and militia, to hold divisions, brigades, artillery and airfields. The Bangladesh Liberation Army, formed from Bengali soldiers, police and personnel who left the East Pakistan Rifles, initially operated in small units in villages, along riverbanks and near the borders, and only later developed battalions, brigades and a combined command. India crossed the frontier on March 27 and committed forces to East Pakistan, becoming another direct belligerent; its troops advanced from the west, north and northwest with air and naval support. The Indian Navy struck Pakistani ships and the military traffic and supply nodes at Chittagong in the Bay of Bengal. The campaign can be followed through a breakdown of the provincial military-administrative structure from March 25 to April, a phase of border insurgency and monsoon resupply from May to October, and a joint offensive phase from November to December.
people: 1971年的指揮並不是一條固定鏈。3月26日，謝赫·穆吉布爾·拉赫曼宣布獨立，並在同一天被拘捕；他代表政治領導與臨時政府，而不是前線作戰指揮。孟加拉籍軍官齊亞烏爾·拉赫曼利用東巴基斯坦遊騎兵的編制、訓練和前同袍網絡，在科米拉等地保存官兵，建立解放軍的參謀、通信和後勤小組；孟加拉籍軍官穆罕默德·阿卜杜勒·加尼·奧斯馬尼在4月被任命為解放軍總指揮，負責把各戰區的游擊隊、營旅和砲兵接成一個作戰系統。巴基斯坦方面，A.A.K.尼亞茲負責東巴基斯坦的整體軍事指揮；哈立德·莫沙拉夫指揮達卡的第五十三步兵師，承受達卡方向最密集的進攻；A.K.M.沙馬蘇丁在吉大港指揮第三十四步兵師。印度方面，J.F.R.雅各布任東方指揮部最高指揮官，K.M.帕爾薩亞負責第十四軍，K.R.維里負責第三十三軍；第八步兵師、第一裝甲師及山地部隊分別支援達卡、北部平原和吉大港方向。前線的實際命令仍取決於通信是否中斷、據點是否被包圍，以及營長能否取得彈藥和燃料，所以三方的指揮層級相近，決策速度卻不同。
peopleEn: Command in 1971 was not a single fixed chain. On March 26, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman declared independence and was arrested the same day; he represented political leadership and the provisional government, not frontline command. Ziaur Rahman used the East Pakistan Rifles' organization, training and network of former colleagues to preserve Bengali troops around Comilla and elsewhere, and to build staff, communications and logistics sections for the liberation force. In April, the Bengali officer M. A. G. Osmani was appointed overall commander, connecting guerrilla zones, battalions, brigades and artillery into one operational system. On the Pakistani side, A. A. K. Niazi held overall military command in East Pakistan; Khaled Mosharraf commanded the 53rd Infantry Division at Dhaka and bore the heaviest attacks there; A. K. M. Shamsuddin commanded the 34th Infantry Division at Chittagong. On the Indian side, J. F. R. Jacob headed the Eastern Command, K. M. Parsaiya commanded the XIV Corps, and K. R. Wiri commanded the 33rd Corps; the 8th Infantry Division, 1st Armoured Division and mountain units supported the Dhaka, northern plain and Chittagong directions. Actual orders still depended on whether communications held, whether a position was surrounded, and whether a battalion commander could obtain ammunition and fuel, so the three command systems had similar formal layers but very different decision speeds.
kits: 1971年以前已列裝的裝備，決定了雙方能打什麼樣的仗。巴基斯坦陸軍的裝備包括Type 59中型坦克、M47與M48巴頓坦克，砲兵使用英制4.5英寸榴彈炮、105毫米制式野戰炮和155毫米炮，並以3英寸迫擊炮、81毫米迫擊炮、7.62毫米通用機槍、M2勃朗寧重機槍及9毫米Sterling衝鋒槍構成營連火力。巴基斯坦空軍可用機隊包括F-86F、Mirage III、B-57 Canberra和Alouette II，但基地、航程與燃油限制使它們不可能全程集中在東翼；海軍則依靠PNS Khaibar等舊式海軍艦艇、登陸艇與掃雷艇。印度地面部隊以Vickers Vijayanta、M47和M48建立裝甲核心，配備105毫米與155毫米榴彈炮、81毫米迫擊炮、7.62毫米步槍、Sterling衝鋒槍和106毫米反裝甲槍，並有裝甲運兵與修理車。印度空軍使用MiG-21、MiG-17、Su-7、Il-28和HS 748；海軍使用INS Vikrant的艦載機、Alouette III、Sea King直升機及驅逐艦、護衛艦的火砲。解放軍早期繳獲巴基斯坦的步槍、機槍、迫迫炮、坦克與砲彈，後來又從印度補給線取得7.62毫米彈藥、9毫米彈藥、81毫米炮彈、反裝甲武器和通信器材。105與155毫米炮彈、迫擊炮彈、燃料和備件能否按時送到前線，往往比武器數量更決定火力；火車、卡車、河道船隻、渡船和空運共同構成補給網，橋梁受損時便改走縱道路線。同一型號是否配給某一支隊，會因部隊而異，以上只列1971年或更早已存在的真實裝備。
kitsEn: The equipment already fielded by 1971 determined what kind of war each side could fight. The Pakistan Army had Type 59 medium tanks and M47 and M48 Patton tanks; its artillery included British 4.5-inch howitzers, 105-mm field guns and 155-mm guns, while 3-inch and 81-mm mortars, 7.62-mm general-purpose machine guns, Browning M2 heavy machine guns and 9-mm Sterling submachine guns provided battalion and company firepower. The Pakistan Air Force's available force included F-86F fighters, Mirage III aircraft, B-57 Canberra aircraft and Alouette II helicopters, although bases, range and fuel limitations prevented them from concentrating in the eastern theater throughout the campaign. The navy relied on PNS Khaibar and other older naval vessels, landing craft and minesweepers. The Indian ground force built its armored core around Vickers Vijayanta, M47 and M48 tanks, with 105-mm and 155-mm howitzers, 81-mm mortars, 7.62-mm rifles, Sterling submachine guns and 106-mm recoilless rifles, along with armored transport and recovery vehicles. The Indian Air Force used MiG-21s, MiG-17s, Su-7s, Il-28s and HS 748s; the navy used aircraft from INS Vikrant, Alouette III and Sea King helicopters, and the guns of destroyers and escort ships. Early Mukti Bahini units captured Pakistani rifles, machine guns, mortars, tanks and artillery ammunition, and later received 7.62-mm and 9-mm ammunition, 81-mm mortar rounds, anti-armor weapons and communications equipment from Indian supply lines. Whether 105- and 155-mm shells, mortar ammunition, fuel and spare parts reached the front often mattered more than the nominal weapons count; trains, trucks, river craft, ferries and airlift formed the supply network, and detours were made when bridges failed. Allocation of a given model varied by unit; this list includes only real equipment already in service by 1971.
tactics: 作戰方法隨地形而變。巴基斯坦在達卡、吉大港和科米拉保持機甲、砲兵與營地防衛，依賴檢查站、河岸火力網和空軍巡邏；其部隊常以營或旅為單位守住道路與城鎮。反過來，解放軍在3、4月的典型做法是夜間接近，切斷公路和通信，攻擊孤立的警察分遣所、遊騎兵哨所與彈藥庫，打一擊即撤，避免讓游擊隊長時間暴露在砲火下。4月初，部分駐防科米拉與達烏德坎迪的孟加拉籍部隊轉向，奪取軍械、彈藥和車輛，使解放軍很快有了比初期完整的火力。巴基斯坦的固定陣地因此能被包圍，而鄉村的道路和通信卻難以同時守住。到了5月，當解放軍能以小組穿越稻田和河道、印度部隊能在邊境站穩腳跟時，雙方才逐步把游擊戰接到營、旅作戰上。印度在邊境奪取橋頭後，以第十四軍、第三十三軍和101區的縱深部隊沿多條道路向內推進；北線經米姆辛吉、丹吉爾、納爾辛吉逼近達卡，中線由博格拉向達卡，西南方向則由賈索爾、庫爾納一帶維持交通與側翼，第一裝甲師利用Vijayanta和M47、M48突破開闊地，第八步兵師則向達卡壓縮，最後與解放軍的突擊部隊包圍市郊和主要營地。科米拉至吉大港的走廊則由印度山地部隊與解放軍配合。5月中旬的Barisal行動是一次有限邊界攻勢，目標在切斷邊境據點和後勤，而不是立即占領達卡。6月至10月季風限制車輛通行，雙方轉向河道、堤道和島嶼，解放軍用夜襲、伏擊和短期奪點保存兵力；巴基斯坦則用固定陣地、砲兵和空軍巡邏守住交通節點，邊境砲擊與空襲也持續進行。11月後，解放軍在達卡周邊實施多方向攻擊，印度部隊加快推進；海軍在12月4日開始的Trident行動中攻擊吉大港海上交通和岸基航空設施，切斷外海補給，12月15日夜至16日凌晨PNS Khaibar在吉大港外海被擊中沉沒。12月12日裝甲先頭進入達卡，14日第五十三師投降，16日吉大港主要守軍投降，攻勢才結束。
tacticsEn: Tactics changed with the terrain. Pakistan maintained armored, artillery and cantonment defenses at Dhaka, Chittagong and Comilla, relying on checkpoints, riverbank fire networks and air patrols; its units commonly held roads and towns with battalions or brigades. In March and April, the typical Mukti Bahini method was to approach at night, cut roads and communications, attack isolated police detachments, East Pakistan Rifles posts and ammunition depots, then move away before a guerrilla unit was kept under artillery fire for long. In early April, some Bengali units stationed around Comilla and Daudkandi changed sides, seized weapons, ammunition and vehicles, giving the liberation force a more complete fire base than it had at the start. Pakistan's fixed positions could therefore be surrounded, while roads and communications in the countryside could not be held everywhere at once. By May, when Mukti Bahini groups could cross rice fields and waterways and Indian units could hold border bridgeheads, the two sides gradually connected guerrilla war to battalion and brigade operations. After taking border bridgeheads, India advanced along several axes with the XIV Corps, 33rd Corps and 101 Area: the northern route passed through Mymensingh, Tangail and Narsingdi toward Dhaka; the central route ran from Bogra toward Dhaka; and in the southwest, forces around Jessore and Khulna maintained communications and the flank. The 1st Armoured Division used Vijayanta and M47/M48 tanks to break across open ground, while the 8th Infantry Division compressed the approaches to Dhaka and joined Mukti Bahini strike units in surrounding the outskirts and major camps. The Comilla-Chittagong corridor was worked by Indian mountain units and Mukti Bahini. The Barisal operation in mid-May was a limited frontier offensive aimed at cutting border positions and logistics, not at immediately taking Dhaka. From June to October, monsoon rains restricted vehicle movement; both sides turned to rivers, embankments and islands, while Mukti Bahini used night attacks, ambushes and short-term seizures to preserve strength. Pakistan used fixed positions, artillery and air patrols to hold transport nodes, and border shelling and air attacks continued. After November, Mukti Bahini attacked Dhaka from several directions and Indian forces accelerated; in the Trident operation beginning December 4, the navy struck Chittagong's maritime traffic and shore-based aviation facilities, cutting seaborne supply. PNS Khaibar was struck and sunk off Chittagong during the night of December 15 and the early hours of December 16. An armored vanguard entered Dhaka on December 12, the 53rd Division surrendered on the 14th, and the main Chittagong defenders surrendered on the 16th.
data: 把可核對的日期和編制放在一起，戰局會更清楚。1970年3月7日，東巴基斯坦舉行選舉，阿瓦米聯盟取得明顯多數；1971年3月7日，非合作運動使政治危機轉成持續性罷工和地方對抗。3月25日，Operation Searchlight在達卡及幾個省會展開，陸軍同時奪取通信、營地和警察機構；3月26日，穆吉布爾宣布獨立並在同一天被拘捕；3月27日，印度越境部隊在邊境奪取陣地，正式介入軍事階段。4月初，解放軍完成第一批常規化編組；5月中旬，印度發動Barisal有限攻勢；6月至10月，季風使大型正面推進受阻，但邊界游擊、砲擊和空襲仍持續，這段時間的主要考驗是火車、渡口、彈藥庫和燃料的可用程度。巴基斯坦在東翼的主要編制包括達卡的第五十三步兵師、吉大港的第三十四步兵師、科米拉一帶的第二十步兵師，以及東巴基斯坦遊騎兵和警察部隊；印度的核心是第八步兵師、第一裝甲師、第三十三軍和第十四軍，並有101區及山地部隊協同。解放軍由游擊分隊擴展為多個戰區、營旅和砲兵分隊，前線武器來源一部分是繳獲，一部分是印度運入。印度把邊界火車和公路運來的7.62毫米步槍彈、81毫米迫擊炮彈及105與155毫米炮彈分送前線各單位；雨季道路中斷時，補給改用卡車、河道船和空運，前沿堆積點則靠近道路、渡口和可防守的營地。各方戰報把作戰、拘押、失聯等不同類別混在一起，統計口徑與宣傳用途也不同；因此本文不列未經交叉核對的精確傷亡總數。11月至12月，巴基斯坦把達卡外圍防線向市區收縮，解放軍與印度部隊同時壓縮包圍圈；12月4日至11日海軍作戰，12日達卡方向突破，14日第五十三師投降，16日吉大港投降，16日至17日的停火安排使戰爭的軍事階段落幕。
dataEn: Putting verifiable dates and formations together makes the course clearer. On March 7, 1970, elections were held in East Pakistan and the Awami League won a clear majority; on March 7, 1971, the non-cooperation movement turned the political crisis into continuing strikes and local resistance. On March 25, Operation Searchlight was launched in Dhaka and several provincial capitals, with the army simultaneously taking communications, cantonments and police installations; on March 26, Mujib declared independence and was arrested the same day; on March 27, Indian forces seized border positions and entered the military phase. In early April, Mukti Bahini completed its first regular formations; in mid-May India launched the limited Barisal offensive; from June to October the monsoon constrained large conventional advances, although border insurgency, artillery fire and air attacks continued. The decisive practical questions in that period were the availability of trains, fords, ammunition depots and fuel. Pakistan's principal formations in the east included the 53rd Infantry Division at Dhaka, the 34th Infantry Division at Chittagong, the 20th Infantry Division around Comilla, and East Pakistan Rifles and police units. India's core included the 8th Infantry Division, 1st Armoured Division, 33rd Corps and XIV Corps, with the 101 Area and mountain units cooperating. Mukti Bahini expanded from guerrilla detachments into multiple sectors, battalion and brigade formations and artillery groups; some weapons were captured and others were brought in from India. India moved 7.62-mm rifle ammunition, 81-mm mortar rounds and 105- and 155-mm shells by border rail and road, then distributed them among frontline units; when monsoon roads broke, supply shifted to trucks, river craft and airlift, with forward points placed near roads, fords and defensible camps. Reports from all sides mixed combat, detention and missing personnel, and their statistical definitions and propaganda uses differed. This account therefore gives no uncross-checked exact total of casualties. From November to December, Pakistan contracted the defenses outside Dhaka toward the city, while Mukti Bahini and Indian forces compressed the encirclement; naval operations ran from December 4 to 11, the Dhaka direction was breached on the 12th, the 53rd Division surrendered on the 14th, Chittagong surrendered on the 16th, and ceasefire arrangements on December 16 and 17 ended the military phase.
cause: 戰爭的直接背景，是東巴基斯坦在政治、軍事和行政權力上長期受西巴基斯坦中央政府控制。東孟加拉的議席、資源、徵稅、外交和軍隊指揮權要求，與中央權力的集中方式衝突；1970年選舉前，東巴基斯坦的主要政黨把聯邦制、語言權、地方政府、經濟利益和國防指揮列為六項政治要求。選舉結果使阿瓦米聯盟取得東巴基斯坦議席的明顯多數，中央軍政府卻延期召開國會、拖延政治程序，拒絕把選舉結果轉成可行的權力安排。1971年3月7日開始的非合作運動，使中央行政、地方警察和交通運作逐漸失去協調；巴基斯坦軍方擔心若不先奪取通信和指揮節點，東巴基斯坦的軍警會成批倒向反政府一方，遂在3月25日以Searchlight行動打擊達卡及其他城市的指揮系統。3月26日的獨立宣告、穆吉布爾被拘押，以及孟加拉籍官兵在4月的集體脫離，使衝突從政治危機轉成內戰式軍對抗。印度介入可概括為三個同時存在的軍事因素：保護邊境和自身空域、阻止巴基斯坦把東翼兵力投向印度側翼，以及利用邊境局勢迫使巴基斯坦停止在東翼的軍事部署。印度政府以邊境防衛和區域安全說明行動，巴基斯坦則把它視為外國入侵；因此，後文按實際戰線、日期、編制和補給記錄，而不把任何一方的政治理由當作唯一原因。
causeEn: The immediate background to the war was the long-standing control of political, military and administrative power in East Pakistan by the central government of West Pakistan. Questions of representation, resources, taxation, foreign affairs and military command in the eastern region conflicted with the concentration of power at the center; before the 1970 election, the principal political party in East Pakistan set out six demands concerning federal structure, language, local government, economic interests and national-defense command. The election gave the Awami League a clear majority of East Pakistan's seats, but the central military government postponed the assembly, delayed political procedures and refused to turn the result into a workable distribution of authority. The non-cooperation movement that began on March 7, 1971, progressively deprived central administration, local police and transport operations of coordination. The Pakistani military feared that unless it seized communications and command nodes first, East Pakistan's soldiers and police would defect in large numbers, so it launched Operation Searchlight on March 25 against command systems in Dhaka and other cities. The independence declaration of March 26, Mujib's arrest and the collective departure of Bengali personnel in April turned a political crisis into an internal military confrontation. India's intervention can be summarized as three overlapping military considerations: protecting the border and its own airspace, preventing Pakistani forces in the east from operating toward India's flank, and using the border situation to force Pakistan to halt military deployments in the east. The Indian government described the operation as border defense and regional security, while Pakistan regarded it as a foreign invasion. The account therefore follows the actual front lines, dates, formations and supply movements rather than treating either side's political explanation as the sole cause.
impact: 1971年的影響首先表現在軍隊與國家結構。巴基斯坦在東翼的第五十三、第三十四等師級部隊失去作戰能力，東巴基斯坦遊騎兵的指揮關係被拆散，達卡和吉大港的空軍、海軍設施受損；這些結果迫使巴基斯坦重新安排陸軍編制、邊境防衛和最高指揮系統。印度完成了一次大規模跨境立體作戰，得到邊境陣地和作戰經驗，也承擔佔領維持、與巴基斯坦長期對抗及日後撤軍的成本；1972年印巴協議處理俘虜、撤軍和雙邊關係安排後，印度軍隊才逐步退回東側邊界。解放軍的游擊和常規化經驗，以及後來轉入新國家軍隊的指揮骨幹，成為孟加拉建軍的核心；陸軍、海軍和空軍在國家成立後重新編制。對外交而言，東巴基斯坦的脫離改變南亞權力平衡，孟加拉國於1974年進入聯合國；對區域安全而言，印度獲得較穩定的東部邊境，但巴基斯坦的軍力與外交長期受這場戰爭牽動。運輸、港口和邊境通信的軍事功能受損，也迫使兩國在戰後優先修復軍用交通、重建指揮網，並處理被俘軍人的移交。
impactEn: The effects of 1971 appeared first in military and state structures. The 53rd and 34th divisional formations and other Pakistani units in the east lost combat effectiveness; the East Pakistan Rifles command network was broken up, and air and naval facilities at Dhaka and Chittagong were damaged. These results forced Pakistan to reorganize its army, border defense and highest command system. India completed a large-scale cross-border combined operation, gained border positions and operational experience, and also assumed the costs of maintaining an occupation, prolonged confrontation with Pakistan and eventual withdrawal. After the 1972 India-Pakistan agreement addressed prisoners, withdrawal and bilateral relations, Indian forces gradually returned to the eastern boundary. The guerrilla and conventional experience of the liberation force, together with the cadre that later entered the new national army, became a core of Bangladesh's military formation; its army, navy and air force were reorganized after the state was established. Diplomatically, the departure of East Pakistan changed the South Asian balance of power, and Bangladesh entered the United Nations in 1974. For regional security, India obtained a more stable eastern border, while Pakistan's military and foreign policy remained shaped by the war for years. Damage to the military functions of transport, ports and border communications also forced the states to prioritize repairing military routes, rebuilding command networks and arranging the transfer of captured personnel.
result: 戰役最後以軍事投降和停火收束，而不是以達卡長時間消耗戰結束。12月12日，印度第一裝甲師先頭部隊進入達卡；解放軍在市郊、公路和通信節點的攻擊，使巴基斯坦第五十三師的退路和指揮所受到壓力。12月14日，哈立德·莫沙拉夫在達卡向印度部隊與解放軍投降，交出師部檔案、通信器材、武器和仍在控制的據點；同一時間，吉大港方向的解放軍與印度部隊已切斷主要公路和海岸線。12月16日，A.K.M.沙馬蘇丁率第三十四師投降，吉大港海軍的組織性抵抗也停止；巴基斯坦接受停火，印度則在17日之後安排撤軍。謝赫·穆吉布爾·拉赫曼獲釋並返回達卡，臨時政府取得全國的實際控制，解放軍隨後改組為孟加拉國軍隊。結果因此包括三個明確變化：東巴基斯坦不再由巴基斯坦軍政府直接管治；達卡、吉大港和邊境要點的主權與軍事指揮轉交新國家；印度軍隊在短暫進入後依協議離開，留下獨立的孟加拉國家機構，以及以解放軍作戰經驗為基礎的軍隊。戰俘移交、撤軍安排和外交承認在隨後數月展開，邊界問題則另行處理。
resultEn: The campaign ended with military surrender and a ceasefire, not with a prolonged attritional defense of Dhaka. On December 12, the vanguard of India's 1st Armoured Division entered Dhaka; Mukti Bahini attacks on the outskirts, roads and communications nodes pressured the 53rd Division's withdrawal routes and headquarters. On December 14, Khaled Mosharraf surrendered in Dhaka to Indian forces and Mukti Bahini, handing over division records, communications equipment, weapons and positions still under control; at the same time, Mukti Bahini and Indian units had cut the main road and coastline in the Chittagong direction. On December 16, A. K. M. Shamsuddin led the 34th Division's surrender, and organized naval resistance at Chittagong ceased. Pakistan accepted the ceasefire, while India arranged its withdrawal after December 17. Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was released and returned to Dhaka, the provisional government gained actual control of the country, and the liberation force was subsequently reorganized as the Bangladesh Army. The result therefore contained three explicit changes: East Pakistan was no longer directly governed by Pakistan's military government; sovereignty and military command over Dhaka, Chittagong and border positions passed to the new state; and Indian troops left after a short entry in accordance with the agreement, leaving an independent Bangladeshi state structure and an army based on Mukti Bahini's combat experience. POW transfers, withdrawal arrangements and diplomatic recognition unfolded in the following months, while border questions were handled separately.
